definitions.explanation: Waste materials produced by metabolism in the body, such as urea, carbon dioxide, and toxins, that need to be eliminated. Common in health, fitness, and beauty contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧。
examples.english: Exercise promotes the elimination of waste products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Drinking plenty of water makes it easier for waste products to leave the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦リンパ→リンパ：06009_rinpa⟧⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体内|たいない}→体内：11556_tainai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たまった{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lymphatic massage is said to have the effect of flushing out waste products that have built up in the body.

notes:
Compound of {老廃|ろうはい} (worn-out and discarded) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (substance). Standard term in health, nutrition, and beauty discussions for metabolic byproducts that should be excreted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}する→排出する：25377_haishutsusuru⟧: to excrete waste products
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる: waste products build up
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to flush out waste products
- ⟦{体内|たいない}→体内：11556_tainai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}: waste products in the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{排泄物|はいせつぶつ}→排泄物：27658_haisetsubutsu⟧: excrement, excreta — the actually excreted matter (urine, feces)
- ⟦{毒素|どくそ}→毒素：16785_dokuso⟧: toxins — harmful substances generally
- ⟦{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧: waste matter (industrial/general) — not biological
